[[Seacrash's Influence]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[wand]] dropped by [[Seacrash, Elder Guardian]], a [[boss]] in [[Maishang Hills]].

==Stats==
:[[Earth damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Earth Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of Earth Magic [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:[[Energy]] +5 (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
